  SELECT pool_code, book_day, signed_cents,
         CAST(julianday(stop_day) - julianday(first_day) AS INTEGER) AS duration,
         CAST(julianday('2025-11-01') - julianday(first_day) AS INTEGER) AS oct_days,
         CAST(julianday('2025-12-01') - julianday(first_day) AS INTEGER) AS nov_days
  FROM premium_tranche
  WHERE book_day <= '2025-11-30'
), earned AS (
  SELECT pool_code, signed_cents,
         CASE WHEN book_day <= '2025-10-31' THEN signed_cents * min(duration, max(0, oct_days)) / duration ELSE 0 END AS oct_earned,
         signed_cents * min(duration, max(0, nov_days)) / duration AS nov_earned
  FROM tranches
)
SELECT pool_code, sum(nov_earned - oct_earned) AS november_earned_cents,
       sum(signed_cents - nov_earned) AS closing_unearned_cents
FROM earned
GROUP BY pool_code
ORDER BY pool_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-mural-progress-payment": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT mural_code, review_no, source_id, earned_cents,
         earned_cents / 10 - CASE WHEN earned_cents % 10 < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS held_cents,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY mural_code ORDER BY review_no DESC) AS position
  FROM mural_review
)
SELECT r.mural_code, r.source_id AS review_source, r.held_cents,
       max(0, r.earned_cents - r.held_cents - coalesce((
         SELECT sum(p.cash_cents) FROM cash_posting AS p
         WHERE p.mural_code = r.mural_code AND p.posted_review <= r.review_no
       ), 0)) AS installment_cents

ORDER BY r.mural_code COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-net-currency-pocket-conversion": "WITH nets AS (
  SELECT run_code, pocket_code, sum(source_units) AS net_units
  FROM pocket_entries
  GROUP BY run_code, pocket_code
), fractions AS (
  SELECT n.run_code, n.net_units * q.cent_num AS numerator, q.unit_den AS denominator
  FROM nets AS n JOIN pocket_quotes AS q USING (run_code, pocket_code)
), parts AS (
  SELECT run_code, numerator / denominator AS whole, numerator % denominator AS remainder,
         denominator / 2 + denominator % 2 AS threshold
  FROM fractions
)
SELECT run_code, sum(whole + CASE WHEN remainder >= threshold THEN 1 WHEN remainder <= -threshold THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS payout_cents
FROM parts
GROUP BY run_code
ORDER BY run_code",
  "decision-net-interbranch-premium-settlement-csv": "WITH entries AS (
  SELECT min(beneficiary, funding_branch) AS lo, max(beneficiary, funding_branch) AS hi, ccy,
         CASE WHEN beneficiary < funding_branch THEN allocation_cents ELSE -allocation_cents END AS amount
  FROM funding_entry
  WHERE beneficiary <> funding_branch
), balances AS (
  SELECT lo, hi, ccy, sum(amount) AS net FROM entries

  FROM funding_entry

), payables AS (

         CASE WHEN net > 0 THEN hi ELSE lo END AS creditor, ccy, abs(net) AS cents
